name: discover/detail-actions
title: DetailActions
summary: The action row of one item's page: "Open in Mukoko" (an OpenInApp, primary, the canonical universal link) first, secondary links beside it, and share links under the hint. Every action is a link; never a client script.

props.name: service
props.description: The Mukoko service the item lives in. With `id`, "Open in Mukoko" is `https://mukoko.com/open/<service>/<id>`.

props.name: id
props.description: The item's id in that service.

props.name: href
props.description: An explicit https URL for "Open in Mukoko"; overrides `service` and `id`. One of `href`, or `service` with `id`, is required.

props.name: label
props.description: The primary action's text, e.g. "Join in Mukoko".

props.name: hint
props.default: Opens in the Mukoko app, or on the web if you don't have it.
props.description: What "Open in Mukoko" does; "" for none.

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; external?: boolean }[]
props.description: Secondary actions in the same row, as outline buttons ("Add to calendar", "Read at the source"). `external` sets rel="external noopener".

props.name: share
props.type: { label: string; href: string; external?: boolean }[]
props.description: Share links: share URLs (https://wa.me/?text=…, mailto:…), never a script.

props.name: shareLabel
props.description: The share list's visible label and accessible name.

slots.name: default
slots.description: More actions, after `links` in the same row.

behaviour: Composes OpenInApp (variant primary): the first action in the row is "Open in Mukoko", and the hint is under the row.

With `service` and `id` the primary href is the canonical universal link `https://mukoko.com/open/<service>/<id>`: the apps claim it (universal links, app links), and the resolver in mukoko-dev/super-app-web (`/open/*`) sends anyone without the app to the service's web page for the item. `href` overrides it.
`links`, then the default slot, follow "Open in Mukoko" in the same row, as outline buttons.
Share links are a labelled list under the hint, as ghost buttons; there is no share script and no Web Share API call, so the row has no JavaScript at all.
Never a bare custom scheme: every href is https (or a relative or mailto: link the page supplies).

circle.description: A public circle: a custom label and a slotted action.

article.description: An article: the source as an external secondary link, no hint.

override.description: An explicit href overrides service and id.

keyboard: Tab: "Open in Mukoko", each secondary action, then each share link; Enter follows it.
focus: Every action shows the `--ring` focus ring.
aria: Every action is a link whose text says what it does; the share list is named by `shareLabel` (its visible label is aria-hidden so it is not read twice).

theming.brandOverlay: "Open in Mukoko" fills with `--primary`, so it is the brand's mineral; nothing else follows the brand.

noJs.without: Everything: every action, sharing included, is a link; the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The row wraps: "Open in Mukoko" first, the others after it; the hint and the share links wrap under the row.
contract:
contract
  slot is "detail-actions"
  uses open-in-app
  uses detail-actions-share
  a "Open in Mukoko" min_height 48
  a "Add to calendar" min_height 48
  a "WhatsApp" min_height 48
  a "Join in Mukoko" min_height 48
  when default shows p "Opens in the Mukoko app, or on the web if you don't have it."
  when circle shows a "Start your own circle"
  when article shows a "Read at The Herald"
end

checks.say: "Open in Mukoko" is the canonical universal link, primary.
"Open in Mukoko" comes first in the row.
The share links are a named list.
An external share link is marked.
Never a bare custom scheme, never a button that needs a script.
The circle's own label and its slotted action.
No share links, no share list.
An empty hint is left out.
